name: Status Report
tagline: Crisp white and slate with indigo and traffic-light status pills: a working review deck.

palette.description: clean white with slate ink, one indigo accent and green/amber/red status pills

typography.style: tight modern sans; tables and numbers read at a glance

best_for: Reporting where work stands: project and program status, QBRs, steering committees, board and weekly updates. Has slides for an executive summary with an overall status, four KPIs, a workstream status table, a milestone timeline, progress bars, a risk table, decisions needed and next steps with owners and dates.
avoid_for: Inspirational keynotes, lifestyle brands and anything that should feel playful.
navigation: inline keyboard handler with on-page slide counter
